base_branch_rationale: Wave D branches from wave C because publication state is per record, scope and locale, so it consumes the locale surface.

owner_start_signal.detail: The owner set the goal to implement the whole cluster plan in batch order; this record bounds Batch 3 wave A.

implementation_scope.summary: Publication state per record, scope and locale in one table with the published head as a column, an append-only transition log that answers history and the previous head, four separate access operations plus an explicit sweep, and the rule that a read never publishes.

forbidden_files_note: OperationDescriptor and SyncOperationRuntime are forbidden on purpose: the freeze enforces the v2 policy at registration precisely so that neither has to change.
forbidden_behavior: changing the existing schema, record or version tables in any way
mutating a revision, its values_json or any localized value when publishing
publishing from a read path: a read must never write
treating a scheduled publication as published before the sweep runs
folding publish, unpublish, schedule and archive into one operation with a mode argument
updating or deleting a row in the transition log
adding a public HTTP, REST or MCP surface
changing larena/core, larena/access or any package other than larena/storage
touching larena.test or any live environment
push, release or deployment without a separate owner request
test_plan: Plain-PHP package tests in the existing storage style with an in-memory SQLite capsule mirroring the frozen shapes.
required_tests: publish sets the head for one scope and locale and leaves another scope and locale untouched
the four transitions are four access operations, and each is refused from a state the matrix does not allow
unpublish clears the head, keeps the revision history and returns the head it withdrew
archive clears the head and keeps the revisions
a schedule does not publish, and the head stays what it was
the sweep publishes a due schedule and leaves a future one alone, and it is idempotent
publishing a revision that does not exist for the record is refused
publishing never changes values_json or a localized value
history returns the transitions in order with the from and to state of each
one locale can be published while another stays a draft
the head reads back after a restart on sqlite and mysql
smoke_plan: Migration parity on sqlite and mysql, publish and unpublish in two locales with restart readback of the head and the history, and a sweep run over a due schedule.

action_gate_summary.note: Re-run the action gate inside the core package repository at coding start.

stop_conditions: a frozen table shape, identity grammar, state set or reason code would have to change
an existing schema, record or version table would have to change
the workbench would have to change
a recursive CTE or a MySQL 8 only feature would be required
a file outside the allowed boundary would have to change
an unrecorded product or architecture decision is required
the storage package repository is dirty or not initialized
nonclaims: A launch record authorizes a bounded coding wave; it does not authorize push, release or deployment.
Wave D publishes revisions. Serving them to a public reader is wave E.
The sweep is the contract a queue worker would call; wiring a worker is not part of this batch.

amendments.reason: the localized flag stays in the workbench structure descriptor and is not passed into the storage schema: the schema normalizer has a closed key set of its own and the workbench integration test refused the unknown key immediately
